broad_vina_reference.definition: complete DOCKSTRING support after excluding every row whose raw InChIKey connectivity block occurs in DAVIS or PKIS2

combined_butina.algorithm: RDKit Butina on the combined released panels
combined_butina.cutoff_note: Butina membership is defined by center-neighbor connectivity at the declared cutoff; it does not guarantee that every within-cluster pair has similarity at least the cutoff

claim_boundary: All results are conditional on the fixed 21 kinase targets and released assay panels. These are geometry and target-panel coverage diagnostics, not biological networks, affinity calibration, compound ranking or unseen-target retrieval.

cluster_bootstrap.boundary: conditional chemical-cluster bootstrap within each released panel
cluster_bootstrap.ordinary_bootstrap_role: sensitivity with explicit constant-target failure rate
cluster_bootstrap.selection_contract: raw and residual k=8 Vina panels fixed once on the de-leaked broad DOCKSTRING map before experimental resampling

metadata.coverage: mean over all 21 targets of distance to the nearest selected target
metadata.cross_panel_experimental_transfer: the exact k=8 optimum selected on DAVIS is evaluated on PKIS2 and vice versa
metadata.enumeration: complete lexicographic enumeration; no Monte Carlo panel sample
metadata.oracle: minimum on the named experimental map among all C(21,8) panels
metadata.oracle_boundary: the experimental oracle is selected and evaluated on the same finite map; it is an in-sample descriptive lower bound

metadata.multidescriptor_matching: random unique candidate among the 256 nearest pool molecules in seven-dimensional median/IQR-standardized descriptor space
metadata.mw_matching: one candidate per query ligand from 20 pool-quantile strata

pool.definition: complete DOCKSTRING support after excluding every row whose raw InChIKey connectivity block occurs in DAVIS or PKIS2

metadata.positive_control: map Spearman between two independent equal-N row-disjoint Vina supports from the same de-leaked library
metadata.scaffold_distinct_sensitivity: at most one row per frozen nonempty Bemis-Murcko scaffold; each acyclic source row is its own group. This is a de-redundancy sensitivity, not a matched bootstrap of the observed support.

finalization: result CSVs were atomically completed by the default producer; metadata was reconstructed from those tables after a non-finite JSON serialization guard was corrected

primary_estimands.exact_support_control: fixed experimental map versus an equal-N de-leaked DOCKSTRING Vina map
primary_estimands.map_agreement: Spearman correlation across the 210 strict-upper-triangle edges
primary_estimands.target_map: Pearson correlations among targets after subtracting each ligand's mean across the fixed 21 targets
